tools.name: find_song_key
tools.title: Look up a song’s key by title
tools.description: Look up the key, tempo (BPM) and typical vocal range of a well-known song by its title, in Tera Studio's song list (key and tempo from AcousticBrainz's analyses of the recording). Returns the key with its relative key, how many analyses agree on it, the BPM when they agree, an estimated range, and links to the song's page and to the key changer. Use it when someone names a song and asks its key or tempo, or whether it suits their voice. Pass semitones if they want it higher or lower. A song outside the list comes back as not found, with the key finder and key changer for a file they have.

title.description: The song's title, without the artist.

artist.description: Who sings it, if the person said; it picks between songs that share a title.

semitones.description: How far to move the song for their voice, from -6 to 6 semitones; negative is lower. Leave it out to keep the original key.

tools.name: find_song_key_and_tempo
tools.title: Find a song’s key and tempo
tools.description: Find the musical key (major or minor, with its relative key) and the tempo in BPM of a song file the person has. Opens a small Tera Studio tool where they choose the file; it is analysed in their browser and never uploaded. Use it when someone asks what key or BPM a song is in, or wants to know before singing, mixing or practising it. It reads only the file and doesn't identify or play songs; find_song_key looks up a well-known song by its title.

tools.name: get_own_voice_song_instructions
tools.title: Get own-voice song instructions
tools.description: Explain how to hear a song sung in the person's own voice with Tera Studio, and give them the link to start. They create an account on terastudio.co, sing for about a minute, add a song they have the rights to use, and hear it back in their voice. Use it when someone wants to hear themselves sing a song, make a cover in their own voice, or turn a song into a gift in their voice. It returns steps and a link and creates nothing. Tera Studio only uses the person's own voice: not for celebrity or other people's voices.

song_title.description: The song they want to hear in their voice, if they named one.

language.description: The language the song is sung in, if they said.

occasion.description: What it's for, if they said: a birthday, a wedding, a gift.

tools.name: shift_song_key
tools.title: Change a song’s key
tools.description: Move a song the person has up or down by up to 6 semitones, keeping its speed, so it fits their voice, and play it back. Opens a small Tera Studio tool where they choose the file; the change happens in their browser and nothing is uploaded. Use it when a song is too high or too low for someone. Pass semitones if they said how far (negative is lower); otherwise they choose in the tool.

semitones.description: How far to move the song, from -6 to 6 semitones; negative is lower. Leave it out to let the person choose.

resources.name: song-key-tool
resources.title: Song key and tempo tool
resources.description: Finds a song's key and tempo and moves it to another key, in the person's browser.
